MESHCORE-MIB DEFINITIONS ::= BEGIN

--
-- MeshCore repeater/room-server monitoring MIB
--
-- OID base arc: 1.3.6.1.4.1.62911.1
--   iso(1).org(3).dod(6).internet(1).private(4).enterprises(1).62911.1
--
-- Install:
--   sudo cp MESHCORE-MIB.txt /usr/share/snmp/mibs/MESHCORE-MIB.txt
--   echo "mibs +MESHCORE-MIB" >> /etc/snmp/snmp.conf
--
-- Usage:
--   snmpwalk    -v2c -c public -m MESHCORE-MIB <host> meshCoreMIB
--   snmpget     -v2c -c public -m MESHCORE-MIB <host> meshCoreNodeName.0
--   snmpbulkwalk -v2c -c public -m MESHCORE-MIB <host> meshCoreMIB
--
-- SNMPSET:
--   Groups 1-4 are READ-ONLY (monitoring stats).
--   Groups 5-7 are READ-WRITE (control tree, aclTable, regionTable) --
--   requires SNMP_RW_COMMUNITY if defined, otherwise SNMP_COMMUNITY.
--   Group 5.5 (actions) triggers are WRITE-ONLY; GET always returns 0.
--   SET base.5.5.1.0 = 1 -> reboot
--   SET base.5.5.2.0 = 1 -> clkreboot
--   SET base.5.5.3.0 = 1 -> FACTORY ERASE (destructive, irreversible)
--   SET base.5.5.4.0 = 1 -> flood advert, = 2 -> zero-hop advert
--   SET base.5.5.5.0 = 1 -> clear stats
--

IMPORTS
    MODULE-IDENTITY, OBJECT-TYPE,
    Integer32, Gauge32, Counter32, TimeTicks,
    enterprises
        FROM SNMPv2-SMI
    DisplayString
        FROM SNMPv2-TC
    MODULE-COMPLIANCE, OBJECT-GROUP
        FROM SNMPv2-CONF;


meshCoreMIB MODULE-IDENTITY
    LAST-UPDATED "202506060000Z"
    ORGANIZATION "MeshCore Project"
    CONTACT-INFO "https://github.com/ripplebiz/MeshCore"
    DESCRIPTION
        "MeshCore LoRa mesh node MIB.
         Read-only stats (groups 1-4) plus read/write control tree
         (groups 5-7: scalars, aclTable, regionTable).
         All scalar leaves are base.<group>.<leaf>.0 (MIB-2-style scalars).
         Table entries: base.<group>.1.<column>.<index>.
         DECIMAL VALUES: fractional fields (freq, BW, SNR, duty-cycle,
         lat/lon, delay factors, ADC multiplier) are OCTET STRING holding
         plain ASCII decimal, e.g. '869.525' or '4.25'. Only genuinely
         integer values use INTEGER/Counter32/Gauge32/TimeTicks."
    REVISION "202506060000Z"
        DESCRIPTION "Initial version."
    ::= { enterprises 62911 1 }


-- ============================================================
-- TOP-LEVEL GROUPS
-- ============================================================

meshCoreSysInfo     OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreMIB 1 }
meshCoreRadio       OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreMIB 2 }
meshCorePackets     OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreMIB 3 }
meshCoreBridge      OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreMIB 4 }
meshCoreControl     OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreMIB 5 }
meshCoreAclTable    OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreMIB 6 }
meshCoreRegionTable OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreMIB 7 }

-- Control sub-groups under base.5
meshCoreCtrlRadioHw  OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreControl 1 }
meshCoreCtrlRouting  OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreControl 2 }
meshCoreCtrlSystem   OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreControl 3 }
meshCoreCtrlBridge   OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreControl 4 }
meshCoreCtrlActions  OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreControl 5 }


-- ============================================================
-- 1  sysInfo  (1.3.6.1.4.1.62911.1.1.x.0)  READ-ONLY
-- ============================================================

meshCoreNodeName OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..31))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Human-readable node name (CLI: set name <value>).
         Example: 'Msk0'
         SNMPSET: not supported on this object (use base.5.3.1.0)."
    ::= { meshCoreSysInfo 1 }

meshCoreRole OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..31))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Firmware role compiled into this binary.
         Known values: 'repeater', 'room_server'."
    ::= { meshCoreSysInfo 2 }

meshCoreFirmwareVersion OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..31))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Firmware version string, e.g. 'v1.16.0'."
    ::= { meshCoreSysInfo 3 }

meshCorePublicKeyHex OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..128))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Node identity public key as upper-case hex (64 chars = 32 bytes).
         Stable across reboots; uniquely identifies the node on the mesh.
         Example: '1B6D76FAC327F46D65A0CF00AEAA32CD764FDF1281E5B7F76BA27A525E7DB95C'."
    ::= { meshCoreSysInfo 4 }

meshCoreUptime OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      TimeTicks
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Time since boot in hundredths of a second (standard TimeTicks).
         Derived from firmware uptime_millis / 10. Wraps after ~497 days.
         Example: (7690) = 76.90 seconds uptime."
    ::= { meshCoreSysInfo 5 }

meshCoreBattMilliVolts OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Gauge32
    UNITS       "millivolts"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Battery voltage in millivolts from board ADC.
         0 on hosts without battery monitoring hardware.
         Example: 3742 = 3.742 V."
    ::= { meshCoreSysInfo 6 }


-- ============================================================
-- 2  radioStats  (1.3.6.1.4.1.62911.1.2.x.0)  READ-ONLY
-- ============================================================

meshCoreTotalAirTimeMs OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    UNITS       "milliseconds"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Cumulative radio TX air time since boot (Dispatcher::getTotalAirTime()).
         Drives duty-cycle enforcement. Wraps at 2^32 ms (~49.7 days continuous TX)."
    ::= { meshCoreRadio 1 }

meshCoreRxAirTimeMs OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    UNITS       "milliseconds"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Cumulative radio RX air time since boot (Dispatcher::getReceiveAirTime())."
    ::= { meshCoreRadio 2 }

meshCoreRemainingTxBudgetMs OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Gauge32
    UNITS       "milliseconds"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Remaining TX budget now (Dispatcher::getRemainingTxBudget()).
         0 = node is deferring all TX until budget replenishes.
         High value (e.g. 1799670) means ample budget."
    ::= { meshCoreRadio 3 }

meshCoreNoiseFloor OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    UNITS       "dBm"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Current noise floor from LoRa transceiver, in dBm.
         Less negative = more interference. Example: -104 dBm."
    ::= { meshCoreRadio 4 }

meshCoreLastRSSI OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    UNITS       "dBm"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "RSSI of the most recently received LoRa packet, in dBm.
         Example: -103 dBm."
    ::= { meshCoreRadio 5 }

meshCoreLastSNR OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..12))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "SNR of the most recently received LoRa packet, as decimal ASCII dB.
         Unscaled. Negative values are normal for LoRa.
         Example: '-1.25' means -1.25 dB SNR."
    ::= { meshCoreRadio 6 }

meshCoreDutyCyclePct OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..10))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Configured TX duty-cycle allowance as decimal ASCII percent.
         Unscaled. Derived from: 1 / (1 + airtime_factor) * 100.
         This is the configured ceiling, not live usage.
         Example: '12.50' means 12.50%.
         For live utilization see meshCoreAirtimeUtilPct."
    ::= { meshCoreRadio 7 }

meshCoreAirtimeUtilPct OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..10))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Live airtime utilization as decimal ASCII percent (0.00-100.00).
         Self-measuring: (airtime consumed since last read of this OID) /
         (wall-clock elapsed since last read) * 100.
         Polling interval = averaging window -- poll every 60 s for a
         60-second average.
         First read after boot returns '0.00' (no prior sample).
         Example: '3.72' means 3.72% utilization."
    ::= { meshCoreRadio 8 }


-- ============================================================
-- 3  packetStats  (1.3.6.1.4.1.62911.1.3.x.0)  READ-ONLY
-- ============================================================

meshCoreNumSentFlood OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Flood (broadcast) packets transmitted since boot (Dispatcher::getNumSentFlood())."
    ::= { meshCorePackets 1 }

meshCoreNumSentDirect OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Direct (unicast/routed) packets transmitted since boot (Dispatcher::getNumSentDirect())."
    ::= { meshCorePackets 2 }

meshCoreNumRecvFlood OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Flood packets received and accepted after duplicate filtering (Dispatcher::getNumRecvFlood())."
    ::= { meshCorePackets 3 }

meshCoreNumRecvDirect OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Direct packets received and accepted since boot (Dispatcher::getNumRecvDirect())."
    ::= { meshCorePackets 4 }

meshCoreRadioPacketsRecv OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Raw packets received by radio driver before mesh-layer filtering
         (radio_driver.getPacketsRecv()). Includes duplicates, foreign-network
         packets, and decode failures counted in meshCoreRadioPacketsRecvErrors."
    ::= { meshCorePackets 5 }

meshCoreRadioPacketsSent OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Raw packets handed to radio driver for TX since boot (radio_driver.getPacketsSent())."
    ::= { meshCorePackets 6 }

meshCoreRadioPacketsRecvErrors OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "RX errors from radio driver since boot: CRC failures, header errors, etc.
         (radio_driver.getPacketsRecvErrors()).
         Persistently rising = RF interference or misconfigured channel."
    ::= { meshCorePackets 7 }

meshCoreOutboundQueueLen OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Gauge32
    UNITS       "packets"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Current outbound TX queue depth (_mgr->getOutboundTotal()).
         Should be near 0 normally. Non-zero = congestion or duty-cycle limiting."
    ::= { meshCorePackets 8 }

meshCoreErrFlags OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Gauge32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Bitmask of internal error flags (_err_flags in Dispatcher).
         0 = no errors. Non-zero: correlate with src/Dispatcher.h for the
         firmware version running; bit assignments may change between releases."
    ::= { meshCorePackets 9 }


-- ============================================================
-- 4  bridgeStats  (1.3.6.1.4.1.62911.1.4.x.0)  READ-ONLY
--    Always present. Returns 0 when no bridge compiled in.
-- ============================================================

meshCoreBridgeTxPackets OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Packets forwarded mesh->bridge (e.g. published to MQTT) since boot. 0 if no bridge."
    ::= { meshCoreBridge 1 }

meshCoreBridgeRxPackets OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Packets received from bridge and injected into mesh since boot. 0 if no bridge."
    ::= { meshCoreBridge 2 }

meshCoreBridgeReconnects OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Counter32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Bridge transport reconnections since boot (e.g. MQTT TCP reconnects).
         Rapidly rising = unstable broker connection. 0 if no bridge."
    ::= { meshCoreBridge 3 }

    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "TX duty-cycle allowance ceiling, whole percent integer 1-100.
         SET: CLI set dutycycle <value>.
         Read-back of the live fractional value is at meshCoreDutyCyclePct (base.2.7.0)."

    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..12))

    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..12))

         SET: CLI set directdelay <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlRouting 4 }

meshCoreRtRxDelayBase OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..12))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current

         SET: CLI set rxdelay <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlRouting 5 }

meshCoreRtFloodMax OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..64)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write

    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..255)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION

meshCoreRtFloodMaxAdvert OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..64)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write

         SET: CLI set flood.max.advert <value>."

meshCoreRtPathHashMode OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..2)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Path hash mode, 0-2.
         SET: CLI set path.hash <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlRouting 9 }

meshCoreRtLoopDetect OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..3)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Loop detection mode: 0=off, 1=minimal, 2=moderate, 3=strict.
         SET: CLI set loopdetect <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlRouting 10 }

meshCoreRtInterferenceThresh OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Interference detection threshold (dBm).
         SET: CLI set interference <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlRouting 11 }

meshCoreRtAgcResetIntervalS OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    UNITS       "seconds"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "AGC reset interval in seconds. Firmware rounds to a multiple of 4.
         SET: CLI set agc.reset <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlRouting 12 }

meshCoreRtMultiAcks OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..1)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Multiple ACK transmission. 0 = off, 1 = on.
         SET: CLI set multiack <0|1>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlRouting 13 }

meshCoreRtFloodAdvertHrs OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    UNITS       "hours"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Flood advertisement interval in hours. 0 = disabled, or 3-168.
         SET: CLI set advert.flood <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlRouting 14 }

meshCoreRtAdvertIntervalMins OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    UNITS       "minutes"
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Local advertisement interval in minutes. 0 = disabled, or 60-240.
         Firmware rounds to a multiple of 2.
         SET: CLI set advert.interval <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlRouting 15 }

    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..32))

    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..14))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION

         Example: '51.500000'. SET: CLI set lat <value>."

    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..14))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Longitude as decimal ASCII degrees, signed. Unscaled.
         Example: '-0.125000'. SET: CLI set lon <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlSystem 3 }

meshCoreSysOwnerInfo OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..160))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Owner/contact info string. Use '|' for newline (same as CLI convention).
         SET: CLI set owner <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlSystem 4 }

meshCoreSysGuestPassword OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..64))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Guest password. GET returns 'set' if a password is configured, '' if not
         (never returns the real value). SET writes a new password.
         CLI: set pass <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlSystem 5 }

meshCoreSysAdminPassword OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..64))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Admin password. GET returns 'set' if configured, '' if not
         (never returns the real value). SET writes a new password.
         CLI: set adminpass <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlSystem 6 }

meshCoreSysAllowReadOnly OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..1)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Allow read-only (unauthenticated) client access. 0 = off, 1 = on.
         room_server role only; harmless no-op on repeater.
         SET: CLI set allow.readonly <0|1>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlSystem 7 }

meshCoreSysAdcMultiplier OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..12))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "ADC voltage multiplier as decimal ASCII. Unscaled.
         '0' = use board default. Example: '1.702'.
         SET: CLI set adc.mult <value>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlSystem 8 }

meshCoreSysPowerSaving OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..1)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Power saving mode. 0 = off, 1 = on. Reserved; effect is firmware-version dependent.
         SET: CLI set powersave <0|1>."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlSystem 9 }

-- ============================================================
-- 5.5  control.actions  (1.3.6.1.4.1.62911.1.5.5.x.0)
--      WRITE-ONLY triggers. GET always returns 0.
--      Requires SNMP_RW_COMMUNITY.
-- ============================================================

meshCoreActReboot OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Reboot trigger. SET 1 -> reboot (CLI: reboot).
         Response PDU is sent before rebooting but may not arrive.
         GET always returns 0."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlActions 1 }

meshCoreActClkReboot OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Clock reboot trigger. SET 1 -> clkreboot (CLI: clkreboot).
         GET always returns 0."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlActions 2 }

meshCoreActErase OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Factory erase trigger. SET 1 -> factory erase.
         DESTRUCTIVE AND IRREVERSIBLE -- erases all config and identity.
         GET always returns 0."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlActions 3 }

meshCoreActSendAdvert OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Advertisement trigger. SET 1 -> send flood advert.
         SET 2 -> send zero-hop (local) advert. GET always returns 0."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlActions 4 }

meshCoreActClearStats OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Stats clear trigger. SET 1 -> clear all stats counters (CLI: clear stats).
         GET always returns 0."
    ::= { meshCoreCtrlActions 5 }


-- ============================================================
-- 6  aclTable  (1.3.6.1.4.1.62911.1.6.1.<col>.<index>)
--    index = 1..getAclCount()  (1-based, matches ClientACL row order)
--    Columns: 2=pubKeyHex(ro), 3=permissions(rw), 4=lastActivity(ro)
-- ============================================================

meshCoreAclEntry OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreAclTable 1 }

meshCoreAclPubKeyHex OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..128))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "ACL entry public key as upper-case hex (64 chars = 32 bytes).
         OID: base.6.1.2.<index>.
         Read-only."
    ::= { meshCoreAclEntry 2 }

meshCoreAclPermissions OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..3)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "ACL permissions bitmask for this entry (0-3).
         Bit 0 (1) = read access. Bit 1 (2) = write/admin access.
         Values: 0=none, 1=read-only, 2=write-only(unusual), 3=read+write.
         OID: base.6.1.3.<index>.
         SET: equivalent to CLI setperm <pubkey> <perms>."
    ::= { meshCoreAclEntry 3 }

meshCoreAclLastActivity OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      TimeTicks
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Time of last activity from this ACL entry, in hundredths of a
         second since boot (TimeTicks). 0 = never seen since boot.
         OID: base.6.1.4.<index>."
    ::= { meshCoreAclEntry 4 }


-- ============================================================
-- 7  regionTable  (1.3.6.1.4.1.62911.1.7.1.<col>.<index>)
--    index = 0..getRegionCount()-1  (matches RegionMap::getByIdx(i))
--    index 0 is usually the wildcard '*' region.
--    Columns: 2=id(ro), 3=parentId(ro), 4=name(rw), 5=floodDenied(rw),
--             6=isHome(rw), 7=isDefault(rw)
-- ============================================================

meshCoreRegionEntry OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreRegionTable 1 }

meshCoreRegionId OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Region ID (RegionEntry.id). 0 = wildcard '*' region.
         OID: base.7.1.2.<index>."
    ::= { meshCoreRegionEntry 2 }

meshCoreRegionParentId OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Parent region ID (RegionEntry.parent).
         OID: base.7.1.3.<index>."
    ::= { meshCoreRegionEntry 3 }

meshCoreRegionName OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..32))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Region name. OID: base.7.1.4.<index>.
         SET creates/repositions a NEW region named <value> as a child of
         the region at <index> -- does NOT rename row <index> itself
         (RegionMap has no rename primitive). Equivalent to CLI:
         region put <name> [parent]."
    ::= { meshCoreRegionEntry 4 }

meshCoreRegionFloodDenied OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..1)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Flood denied flag for this region. 0 = flood allowed, 1 = flood denied.
         OID: base.7.1.5.<index>.
         SET 1: CLI region denyf <name>. SET 0: CLI region allowf <name>."
    ::= { meshCoreRegionEntry 5 }

meshCoreRegionIsHome OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..1)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Home region flag. 0 = not home, 1 = home.
         OID: base.7.1.6.<index>.
         SET 1: CLI region home <name>. SET 0: rejected (no clear-home CLI command)."
    ::= { meshCoreRegionEntry 6 }

meshCoreRegionIsDefault OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      Integer32 (0..1)
    MAX-ACCESS  read-write
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION
        "Default region flag. 0 = not default, 1 = default (at most one row).
         OID: base.7.1.7.<index>.
         SET 1: CLI region default <name>.
         SET 0: only accepted on the row that IS currently default; clears default to null."
    ::= { meshCoreRegionEntry 7 }

-- CONFORMANCE
-- ============================================================

meshCoreMIBConformance OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= { meshCoreMIB 99 }
